item.title: Poppy Playtime
item.description: At Boulevard City, step into the eerie world of Poppy Playtime, where an abandoned toy factory hides sinister secrets. This immersive hide-and-seek horror challenge keeps you on edge as every shadow and corner could be a safe haven—or a trap. Combining suspense, mystery, and thrilling interactive gameplay, Poppy Playtime delivers one of most unforgettable and spine-tingling adventures. Book Now

item.title: Riyadh Season: BLVD City
item.description: Boulevard City is one of Riyadh Season’s most iconic entertainment hubs, offering a vibrant mix of attractions, from the dazzling dancing fountain to upscale dining, shopping, theaters, and immersive experiences for all ages. Visitors can explore OLULOU, where a towering dinosaur skeleton offers the perfect photo op, and let kids dive into four imaginative zones at PLAY-TOPIA. For thrill-seekers, Poppy Playtime delivers suspense inside an abandoned toy factory, A Lot Like Life challenges your bravery in a zombie outbreak, and The Conjuring opens October 15 with spine-chilling scenes from the haunted universe of Annabelle. Families can brave the haunted farm at Zeela House, while pop culture lovers enjoy FUNKO (from Nov 15), with giant figures and collectibles, and gamers embark on a real-world adventure inside MINECRAFT (also from Nov 15). Launching December 18, Flying Over Saudi offers a groundbreaking 5D flight experience that takes you on a 7-minute immersive ride above Saudi Arabia’s most iconic landmarks.

item.title: The Groves
item.description: The Groves offers a multi-sensory experience that transforms with each season. Every chapter brighter, richer, and more captivating than the last. From immersive dining concepts to live entertainment, art, and nature-inspired design, The Groves Chapter IV unveils new moments of wonder designed to excite, delight, and inspire.

item.title: Immersive Experience: Flying Over Saudi
item.description: “Flying Over Saudi” at Boulevard City, Riyadh offers a one-of-a-kind tourism and entertainment experience—the first of its kind in the Kingdom—inviting visitors into a fully immersive theater that engages all five senses through stunning visuals, surround sound, realistic motion, touch, and scent. Enjoy a 7-minute aerial tour that feels like flying, taking you across Saudi Arabia’s most breathtaking natural landscapes and iconic landmarks in an unforgettable, awe-inspiring journey through the Kingdom’s highlights. Book Tickets

item.title: Arabic Language Exhibition 28
item.description: From the heart of Riyadh, we were greeted by the light of a unique, inspiring exhibition exploring the depths of the Arabic language, showcasing its deep roots, mature stages of growth, and vast reach, as well as the pride its people hold in it.The Arabic L... المصدر الرسمي: Visit Saudi.

item.title: Arabic Language Exhibition for kids
item.description: This exhibition is one of its kind in the Arab world to be developed by a language institution, focuses on developing children's linguistic awareness of the Arabic language. المصدر الرسمي: Visit Saudi.

item.title: برندة
item.description: منطقة سياحية تجمع الطبيعة الخابة، وااجواء الترفيهية بمطلا على أبها، وساحة فنونٍ بطابعٍ عسيري، ومقاهي ومطاعم في أجواءٍ راقية.

item.title: سكاي فيلج
item.description: يقدّم سكاي فيلج في أبها تجربة صيفية بموقع جبلي مرتفع وإطالة مفتوحة، ويضم مطاعم، وكافيهات، ومساحات مفتوحة، وأنشطة ترفيهية تناسب العائات.

item.title: Eishha (Live It) Fan Zone For FIFA World Cup 2026
item.description: Live It (Eshha) is one of Riyadh’s largest sports entertainment and family fan zones during the FIFA World Cup 2026. Designed to capture the excitement of the tournament, the venue features giant match screens, live entertainment, gaming zones, and interactive experiences for football fans of all ages. Book Now

item.title: Coca-Cola Fan Zone For FIFA World Cup 2026
item.description: The Diriyah Biennale Foundation, in partnership with Coca-Cola, presents the Coca-Cola Fan Zone at JAX District, offering football fans a vibrant public viewing experience of the FIFA World Cup 2026™. Hosted within JAX District’s iconic warehouses, the fan zone features large cinema-grade screens, dedicated viewing galleries, and coverage of Saudi Arabia’s matches alongside key global fixtures through to the final. Visitors can also enjoy e-gaming zones, interactive football challenges, family areas, and curated entertainment activities, creating an immersive destination where sport, culture, and community come together in Riyadh. Book Now

item.title: Sikkat Al-Atimah (Street Food) Fan Zone – FIFA World Cup 2026
item.description: Sikkat Al-Atimah (Street Food) Fan Zone offers a unique FIFA World Cup 2026 viewing experience in the heart of Historic Riyadh, within the Qasr Al-Hukm District near Souq Al Zal. Combining the excitement of live matches with the charm of one of the city's most iconic heritage destinations, the fan zone features dedicated viewing areas, a giant screen, immersive audio-visual experiences, and family-friendly entertainment. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of food and beverage offerings, photo opportunities, and convenient access via Riyadh's public transport and metro network.

item.title: World Cup 2026 Fan Zone at Kimpton KAFD
item.description: Experience FIFA World Cup 2026 matches live at Kimpton KAFD, where a giant screen by the pool creates a vibrant atmosphere in the heart of KAFD. Guests can enjoy live match screenings alongside a selection of food and beverages, offering a distinctive setting to gather with friends and family and enjoy the excitement of the tournament. The experience extends beyond matchdays with lifestyle and hospitality programming designed to keep the summer football spirit alive, allowing guests to continue enjoying the atmosphere, entertainment, and social experiences throughout the season. Book Now

item.title: Solitaire Fan Zone – FIFA World Cup 2026
item.description: The Solitaire Fan Zone brings football fans together for an immersive FIFA World Cup 2026 viewing experience, featuring live match screenings in a stadium-inspired atmosphere. Visitors can enjoy a variety of entertainment activities, interactive challenges, and experiences throughout the tournament. The fan zone also features a diverse selection of brands across food and beverages, perfumes, fashion, and gaming, creating a vibrant destination for football enthusiasts, friends, and families alike. Book Now

item.title: Coca-Cola Fan Zone at JAX District
item.description: JAX District in Diriyah will host the Coca-Cola Fan Zone from June 11 to July 19. The fan zone is a dedicated destination for football fans, bringing together live match screenings, entertainment activities, and interactive experiences in an atmosphere suitable for all ages. The venue gives visitors the opportunity to enjoy the excitement of the tournament beyond the stadiums, with spaces designed to make every match a shared experience filled with energy and support.

item.title: Ruh Space
item.description: Experience the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Ruh Space, a premium fan destination located in VIA Riyadh. Designed for football enthusiasts, the venue offers live match screenings in an upscale setting that combines the excitement of the tournament with exceptional hospitality. Guests can enjoy curated dining experiences from renowned restaurants, including Madeo and Ferdi, alongside a range of tailored experiences that create a memorable World Cup atmosphere in the heart of Riyadh. Book Now

item.title: Laysen Fan Zone – FIFA World Cup 2026
item.description: Laysen Valley Fan Zone offers football fans a lively destination to enjoy FIFA World Cup 2026 matches live on giant screens alongside fellow supporters. Designed to capture the excitement of the tournament, the fan zone combines live match viewing with a vibrant atmosphere and shared fan experiences. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of food and beverage options, entertainment activities, and a welcoming environment, making it an ideal destination for friends, families, and football enthusiasts throughout the tournament. Book Now

item.description: فعالية تجمع التسوق والترفيه، وتضم صالات تسوق لمنتجات محلية، وخليجية، ودولية، ومدينة ماه متكاملة، وفعاليات ترفيهية متنوعة لمختلف الأعمار.

item.title: Summer Camp at the National Museum: Summer Wonders
item.description: Summer Wonders is the National Museum's summer program, offering interactive learning experiences for children and families through creative workshops, storytelling, games, hands-on activities, and live musical performances. The program encourages participants to explore history, culture, design, and technology through engaging activities that inspire creativity and discovery. Visitors can enjoy a variety of experiences, including family challenges, interactive exhibitions, craft workshops, shadow storytelling, educational games, and music evenings. Program Highlights Interactive family activities and storytelling experiences. Creative workshops for all ages. Educational games and hands-on learning. Musical performances every Friday. Interactive installations and museum exploration activities. Design, creativity, and technology experiences. Workshops Creative workshops are held every Thursday and Friday at The Studio, with multiple sessions available throughout the day. Activities are suitable for all ages. Register Now Visiting Hours Saturday–Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM Thursday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM Friday: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Sunday: Closed

item.title: Kashtah
item.description: Kashtah brings the charm of a traditional outdoor gathering to Al-Hadabah Park in Abha, creating a family-friendly destination where nature, adventure, and relaxation come together. المصدر الرسمي: Visit Saudi.

item.title: صيف غابة رغدان في الباحة 2026
item.description: تجربة صيفية متكاملة تضم باقة متنوعة من الفعاليات الترفيهية والثقافية والعائلية، تقام في غابة رغدان، وتقدم مزيجًا فريدً في من الطبيعة الجبلية واانشطة التفاعلية وتجارب الطعام.

item.description: تضم قرية الأطاولة التراثية في الباحة سوق ربوع قريش التاريخي، وحصونًا عريقة، وعمارة جبلية، مما يجعلها وجهة سياحية مميزة. قرية الأطاولة التراثية ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الباحة. تبدأ الفعالية ٠١‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ١٢:٠٠ ص وتنتهي ٣١‏/٠٨‏/٢٠٢٦، ١١:٥٩ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تعرض الصفحة وقت الفعالية وموقعها ومصدرها وروابط التقويم والاتجاهات عند توفرها. المصدر: Visit Saudi Summer Calendar PDF.

item.title: Taste of the World
item.description: استمتع بمهرجان ،Taste of the World تجربة طعام عالمية تجمع نكهات من مختلف دول العالم في مكان واحد، مع أكشاك طعام وطهاة عالماين وتجارب تذوّق حيّة.

item.title: مهرجان المأكولات الشعبية
item.description: احتفل بثقافة الطعام المحلي في مهرجان المأكولات الشعبية، حيث يجتمع الطهاة وااسر المنتجة استعراض تنوع المطبخ السعودي الأصيل في أجواء عائلية.

item.title: Esports World Cup
item.description: The Esports World Cup 2026 returns to Riyadh from 6 July to 23 August, delivering a summer-long celebration of elite competition and live entertainment as top clubs and players battle across multiple genres and platforms. With a lineup spanning tactical shooters, MOBAs, fighting games, strategy, racing, and even chess—including global favourites such as League of Legends, Counter-Strike 2, Fortnite, and Rocket League—the festival reinforces Riyadh’s role as a leading hub for international esports. New for 2026, Trackmania joins the programme, bringing high-precision racing where competitors chase the fastest times on one of esports’ most skill-intensive stages. The Esports World Cup, a multi-game global esports tournament and festival, will unite the global e-gaming community, including players, fans, game producers, and publishers, with a focus on fostering connections and collaborations.

item.description: يقدّم "كام فاضي" عرض عمر الجمل، ستاند أب تفاعلي يصبح فيه الجمهور جزءاً من العرض. عمر الجمل - حفلة ستاند أب كوميدي ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الرياض. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ١٢:٠٠ ص وتنتهي ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ١١:٥٩ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تعرض الصفحة وقت الفعالية وموقعها ومصدرها وروابط التقويم والاتجاهات عند توفرها. المصدر: Visit Saudi Summer Calendar PDF.

item.title: Build & Play Together
item.description: A guided activity space where children take part in simple building tasks, group play, and short storytelling moments. The program introduces simple ideas about homes and daily life across cultures through hands-on participation.

item.title: Leap Then Look!
item.description: An intractive exhibition that encourages play and collabration, Inviting visitors to assemble and combine different aculptures to create a collaborative artwork while exploring the senses and imagination.

item.title: Beaded plant Suncatcher
item.description: Sunlight has a way of bringing a space to life. As it passes through a window, it fills a room with color, movement, and small moments that make a house feel like home. In this workshop, participants create beaded plant sun catchers inspired by the light that streams through our windows and the natural elements we welcome into our homes. By combining colorful beads and delicate forms, each piece is designed to catch and reflect sunlight, creating shifting patterns of color and light. The result is a decorative artwork that celebrates the warmth of home through nature, color, and light.

item.title: Puppet World
item.description: Step into Puppet World, a magical roaming experience where giant luminous puppets come to life, transforming Children's festival into a world of wonder and imagination. wering above the crowd, these illuminated characters gracefully dance, interact with visito and create unforgettable moments for audiences of all ages. Don't miss the chance of attending this parade with family and friends!

item.title: PFL MENA Fight Night
item.description: Riyadh is hosting PFL MENA Fight Week, bringing together some of the region's top mixed martial arts (MMA) athletes for an exciting week of competition and fan engagement. The main Professional Fighters League MENA Fight Night will take place on Friday, 10 July, at the Global Theater in Boulevard City. Fighters will share their preparations before completing the official weigh-in ahead of the tournament. Held under the Professional Fighters League (PFL) MENA, the event follows the league's signature "win-and-advance" format, providing Arab athletes with a pathway to compete for championship titles while supporting the growth of mixed martial arts across the Middle East and North Africa. Book Now

item.title: Ajeeb in Wonder House
item.description: A story-led experience that follows Ajeeb as he visits a series of unusual homes, each shaped by a different idea, form, or function. As the story unfolds, children observe how each space reflects a way of living, then shift into designing a home that suits Ajeeb himself. The activity combines storytelling with creative decision-making, moving from observation to design.

item.title: 1, 2, 3, A Little Space for Me
item.description: Small spaces can hold big discoveries. Designed for children under three with their parents, this environment is divided into three distinct zones: movement, hands-on exploration, and quiet play. Each area offers a different way to engage, from active motion to focused interaction and calm building. The experience supports early development through movement, touch, and shared exploration.

item.title: 1, 2, 3, Let's Rhyme!
item.description: Come sing along with us as we explore beloved nursery rhymes, discover new ones, and enjoy a wonderful storytelling experience. Connect with other families in a welcoming environment that promotes early childhood development and provides lots of entertainment. This session, lasting for 30 minutes, is ideal for children aged 0 to 3 years.

item.title: A Home I Imagine
item.description: A home can begin as an idea and take shape in many forms. In this workshop, imagination leads the design process. Through drawing, building, and assembling materials, children develop their own vision of a home and translate it into a tangible model. Each creation results in a constructed home that reflects personal ideas and vision.

item.title: Around the Table
item.description: An interactive activity where children explore how dining tables bring together different cultural practices. The program introduces a range of customs and habits from around the world, showing how the way people gather, sit, and share meals can differ from one place to another. Through simple role-play, children take part in everyday moments such as greeting others, welcoming guests, and spending time around a table.

item.title: Balloon Shapes Lab
item.description: Children twist and shape balloons into different forms, experimenting with how each movement changes the shape. Balloon Shapes Lab ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الظهران. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٤:٠٠ م وتنتهي ٢٥‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: Ithra Events.

item.title: Built by Nature
item.description: A bird’s nest, a termite mound, a shell, each one is carefully built, not by chance, but by need. In this workshop, children observe how living things design their homes, then borrow these ideas to sketch and shape their own. Openings for air, layers for protection, and smart use of materials begin to appear in their designs. What starts in nature slowly turns into a built form.

item.title: Children's Café
item.description: Step into the Children’s Café, a truly unique experience created just for your child! A space where little ones can enjoy their very own café moment, designed at their scale, where they choose, create and explore freely. From decorating their treats at the Art Toppings Station to relaxing in a cozy Reading Corner, every detail is made to spark joy and imagination. It’s more than a café... it’s a first-of-its-kind experience where children gain confidence in their creativity.

item.title: Hidden Home Bingo
item.description: A simple object at home might have a story that starts far beyond the room it sits in. In this fast-paced bingo challenge, children move through clues and questions, connecting everyday items to the materials behind them. As matches come together, unexpected links appearو turning familiar spaces into something to decode and discover.

item.title: Insightful Spaces
item.description: The way we experience a space is shaped by what we feel under our feet, not just what we see. In this sensory journey, children touch different carpeted surfaces, noticing textures, patterns, and subtle changes in sensation. As they explore, they begin to recognize how materials influence comfort, sound and perception in everyday spaces.

item.title: Interactive Exhibit
item.description: An open-ended interactive exhibition that invites children to explore, create, and play through hands-on experiences. It encourages curiosity, imagination, and discovery for children and their families.

item.title: Let’s Decorate!
item.description: Decorations change depending on the occasion, the place, and the people. At the Inspiration Spot, children get inspired to make different styles to celebrate.

item.title: Mic Moments
item.description: Everyday life is full of small details, routines, habits, and traditions that differ from one home to another. In this street mic–style activity, children respond to short, guided questions about their daily life. The format is open and conversational, allowing them to speak, listen, and hear different perspectives in a simple setup.

item.title: Mirror Or Window
item.description: Some images reflect what we already know, others reveal something new. In this interactive experience, artworks are explored as shifting viewpoints. Certain scenes echo familiar memories, while others introduce different ways of living and seeing the world. Through guided observation and creative response, children interpret what they see and translate it into visual expression. The experience results in personal interpretations shaped by both recognition and discovery.

item.title: My Family Bouquet
item.description: A bouquet grows, one flower at a time. In this hands-on workshop, children begin with simple shapes and watch them take form as each piece is rolled, combined, and built into a flower. Colors are chosen, details are added, and the process repeats, each new bloom adding to the whole. As the bouquet comes together, each flower stands for someone at home, gathered into one arrangement shaped through making and choice.

item.title: Our Place on Earth
item.description: A house in the desert is not built like one by the sea, and for good reason. In this experience, children explore how homes respond to their environments, from heat to movement to moisture. This leads into building and testing simple structures, adjusting them to stand against different conditions.

item.title: Painted Faces
item.description: What's a festival without facepainting? Children choose from a variety of designs and have them painted using safe, child-friendly colors.

item.title: Treasures in Every Home
item.description: Deep within the Earth, metal begins its journey, formed over time and transformed into materials we use every day at home. In this interactive workshop, children follow this journey, then reshape a simple tin container into a new functional object. The activity introduces how materials can be reused and redesigned for new purposes..

item.title: Where We Belong
item.description: Look closely at Earth, and it begins to feel like a system that never stops working; air moving, water cycling, living things adapting. In this program, children explore how life continues and changes across different environments, and how organisms adjust to survive over time. The journey then stretches further, looking at how science studies these systems and reimagines them beyond Earth. The experience connects life, environment, and possibility in one continuous story.

item.title: Who Lived Here?
item.description: Every landscape shapes the homes built within it. This treasure hunt in Rehlaat Gallery, children follow clues across three environments: desert, mountain, and coast. Each stop reveals a model home designed in response to its surroundings, from materials and structure to layout and function. As they move between locations, children match clues to the correct homes, discovering how climate, terrain, and daily life influence the way people build and live.

item.title: Zoom In
item.description: A tiny fragment holds the clue. In this Praise of the Artisan treasure hunt, children begin with a zoomed-in detail taken from a larger artwork, a pattern, texture, or small visual hint. Moving through the space, they search for the full piece, matching what they see up close with what appears on the walls. As the search unfolds, attention shifts to details that are often overlooked, building observation skills through careful looking. Each match reveals the complete artwork behind the fragment.

item.title: In the Home of…
item.description: Some homes are easy to recognize. Others leave clues behind. In this interactive library experience, children move through a series of spaces, each one arranged as a “home” shaped by a well-known literary character. Objects, layouts, and small details hint at who might live there. As they explore each corner, children follow prompts and challenges that guide them to observe, connect, and identify the character behind each space. The experience unfolds step by step, turning the library into a trail of clues where stories are discovered through place, detail, and interaction.

item.title: My Little Fort
item.description: Many children create small spaces of their own at home—under a table, behind cushions, or inside a blanket fort. In this hands-on activity, children build their own small “fort” using soft materials, shaping a space they can define and arrange. The session ends with a short story connected to the idea of shared spaces and home.

item.title: My Neighbor Totoro
item.description: A gentle and magical tale by Studio Ghibli that celebrates the innocence of childhood, the quiet beauty of nature, and the meaning of home found in family. Through the eyes of two sisters who move to the countryside, the story unfolds into a world of forest spirits and unseen friends.

item.title: On This Carpet
item.description: in Echoes of the Familiar Gallery, around every corner, a story unfolds. This workshop takes place on a carpet filled with familiar scenes, where everyday moments take shape through storytelling and creative exploration. Children move through these scenes, connecting details, building narratives, and expressing their ideas through drawing and simple story-making. Each visit brings together small moments into a larger picture, shaped by observation, memory, and imagination.

item.title: Sense the Home
item.description: A sensory space where children explore textures, sounds, and scents inspired by everyday life at home Sense the Home ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الظهران. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٥:٠٠ م وتنتهي ٢٥‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: Ithra Events.

item.title: Water Challenges
item.description: Summer is here and you know what that means… the water challenges are back! With all-new fun water-based challenges and activites, and a special surprise to end the day with! A set of outdoor water-based activities where children move between water games that include pouring, splashing, and balancing tasks.

item.title: The House of Ideas
item.description: We begin with a simple question: Where do ideas live? Like us, ideas need a place where they feel safe in a space that inspires them and gives them room to grow. In this experience, we explore the House of Ideas: where we will see how a thought begins, what nurtures it and how we can create spaces that allow it to flourish. By designing a pop-up house inside a notebook, participants build a small, personal world where their ideas can live and take shape. Through cutting, folding and creating, a quiet reflection unfolds: what helps our ideas grow, and where do they truly belong

item.title: House of Wonder
item.description: Wonder House is an interactive experience full of surprises and fun activities, taking children on a journey of discovery, imagination, and excitement.

item.title: Beast House
item.description: Your weekend is set at Beast House, Riyadh’s first music & creative members club. المصدر الرسمي: MDLBEAST. Beast House ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في الرياض. تبدأ الفعالية ١٠‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٩:٠٠ م وتنتهي ١١‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٣:٠٠ ص حسب البيانات المتاحة. تتوفر لها صفحة جدول حي تساعد الزائر على متابعة الحالة والوقت أثناء الحضور. المصدر: MDLBEAST Events.

item.title: Kindergarten Under the Palm Tree (English)
item.description: Produced by the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), a new animated series makes its debut! Set in the diverse environments of Saudi Arabia, small animals embark on charming adventures, discovering the meaning of early emotions such as gratitude and joy in a warm world designed for young children.

item.title: Unbox Your Story
item.description: What if we combine reality with fantasy? How would that enrich your story? Join us for a fun family experience as you discover a new world of stories full with boundless imagination and possibilities. All you have to do is open the box in front of you to reveal the tools and materials within. Begin creating your characters and designing your plot with the various elements available to you. Unleash your creativity and share your new story with those around you!

item.title: Storyteller of the Day
item.description: Do you have the experience or desire to tell stories and would like to be a storyteller at the Ithra Library? Every Wednesday, you have the opportunity to read your favorite stories to the children, nudge them to love books, develop their passion for reading and stimulate their imagination.

item.title: Mishkat Summer Camp
item.description: Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now

item.title: Night at Ithra
item.description: An exclusive family experience for Ithra members. Imagine Ithra transformed into a living, breathing home, where footsteps soften and a new experience begins. “A Night at Ithra” is an immersive evening for families to explore a range of curated spaces across Ithra. The program moves through key locations including the Children’s Museum, library, theater, museum, and outdoor areas, with each stop offering a different activity or perspective. The evening concludes with a shared meal and an optional film screening. Designed for families with children aged 7 and above.

item.title: Nature's Architects
item.description: Nature builds without blueprints, yet every structure serves a clear purpose. The experience begins with a short film that reveals how living organisms design and construct their homes. This is followed by hands-on activities where children explore these ideas further, testing, building, and observing how form responds to need. The workshop connects observation with practical understanding.

item.title: niMú Adventures
item.description: In a world filled with imagination and wonder, niMú embarks on an unexpected journey among suitcases, dreams, and ordinary moments that transform into extraordinary stories. What begins as a simple moment of waiting soon becomes an adventure full of surprises, laughter, and discovery.

item.title: Virtual to Reality
item.description: What begins on a screen doesn’t have to stay there. In this experience, children explore a virtual space, then follow clear steps to bring part of it into the real world. Piece by piece, what was seen on screen becomes something they can build and hold in reality.

item.title: Finding Nemo
item.description: Everything changes when a father clownfish loses his son in a single moment, setting off on a journey across vast distances and endless dangers. Amid the ocean’s shifting waves, the search becomes a test that reveals the strength of family bonds that never break, no matter how far apart they are.

item.title: English Children Book Club (7-9)
item.description: Encourage your children to read books and discuss their insights at the monthly Children's Book Club meetings! Let them read and develop their linguistic, social and conversational skills.

item.title: Kinusaiga Art
item.description: This workshop invites mothers and children to explore the meaning of home through texture, layering and memory. Using the contemporary fabric Japanese art of Kinusaiga, participants will create a fabric piece by choosing materials that feel familiar and comforting. The experience celebrates how home is felt through touch, emotion and personal expression.

item.title: English Children Book Club (10 - 12)
item.description: Are you ready to encourage your children to read books and discuss it at the monthly book club meetings? Let them read and develop their linguistic, social and conversational skills. we are waiting for you!

item.title: Summer Fruits Season in AlUla
item.description: Celebrate the richness of AlUla's summer harvest at the Al Manshiyah Farmers Market. This vibrant event features a range of locally grown fruit, including delicious mangoes, grapes and figs - highlighting AlUla's deep agricultural roots and cultural heritage.

item.title: Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program
item.description: Introduce your children to the richness of Saudi Arabia's traditional arts at the Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program 2026, organized by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts (Wrth). Taking place at Riyadh Park from 16 to 18 July 2026, the program offers children aged 8–12 an enriching summer experience through a sensory, hands-on journey exploring the traditional arts of the Kingdom's diverse regions. Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. Designed to nurture creativity, develop practical skills, and deepen appreciation for Saudi culture, the program provides an engaging environment where young learners can explore, create, and connect with the Kingdom's rich artistic heritage. Book Now

item.title: Tales of the Night Sky (English)
item.description: This magical Mommy and Me experience invites families on a journey through the night sky, beginning with a storytime inspired by traditional Arab tales of the constellations. After the story, we will design constellation cards featuring their favorite star patterns, blending creativity with storytelling. The morning will end with a shared breakfast, offering a special moment to connect, reflect and enjoy quality time together.

item.title: The Magical Suitcase
item.description: A pair of clowns, Wachi and Pica, arrive in town with a giant suitcase, the biggest suitcase you have ever seen. It follows them wherever they go. Beneath this enormous suitcase, you can spot the legs and shoes of four other clowns, their friends. Follow them and discover who they are.

item.title: The Lorax
item.description: In a world where trees have disappeared, a young boy named Ted goes on a journey to discover a real tree. Along the way, he encounters the Lorax, a guardian who speaks on behalf of the trees. This leads to a journey that reveals the importance of protecting nature and caring for the environment.

item.title: Reading and the Child's Personality
item.description: A dialogue session that opens windows of thought, exploring how reading is a vital tool that creates awareness, enhances a child's personality, and develops thinking skills in young children, and transforms the child reader into a expressive and creative individual.

item.title: Sustainability in Children's Literature, Insights and Experiences
item.description: A panel discussion that presents inspiring insights and experiences to transform reading from a transient activity into a sustainable passion.

item.title: Meet with an Expert: Fatimah Sharafeddine
item.description: A meeting rich in dialogue and knowledge, where we meet with an expert specializing in children's literature to open windows of understanding in this vital field that shapes the awareness of future generations. This interactive session combines consultation and in-depth intellectual discussion, in which the expert answers questions and provides specialized insights on how to choose appropriate literature for children, the impact of reading on building a child's personality, and how to enhance their values and skills through the written word. The meeting targets the following groups: - Parents - Teachers and educators - Publishers and writers in children's literature

item.title: Painted Lamps
item.description: Light has a way of bringing a space to life. In this workshop, mothers and children transform simple lamps into personalized creations through painting and decoration. Inspired by the colors, patterns, and details that make a home feel familiar, participants design a glowing piece that is both decorative and functional, bringing a touch of warmth and creativity into their space.

item.title: Today's Story Narrator with Samar Barraj

item.description: This session addresses the journey of the children's book through publishing and translation, and discusses how stories, values, and ideas are conveyed to children across multiple languages and cultures. item.title: From Idea to Narrative: How We Write for Children's Hearts
item.description: The session explores the process of transforming an idea into engaging narratives for children, covering the key elements of building the story, including the narrator's voice, language and educational messages, and how these components can foster a love of reading in children.

item.title: Bringing the Text into Reading Environments
item.description: In this session, we discuss the journey of the text within diverse reading environments, including schools, libraries, digital platforms, and cultural spaces tailored for children. We also explore the factors that contribute to enhancing the presence of engaging texts for children.

item.description: An interactive workshop designed for children to discover the reading boosters that ignite their passion for books, and create a lifelong friendship with reading, making books their closest companions.

Organized by Race Arabia, the event combines fitness and entertainment with splash zones, water activities, and a lively community atmosphere, offering participants of all ages a unique summer running experience. item.description: Step into our creative space and explore a wide variety of new artistic tools and techniques. Enjoy an inspiring interactive experience, featuring artistic showcases designed to spark children’s creativity and develop their artistic sense. Join us and discover what inspires you in a world full of colors, textures, and creative possibilities!

item.title: Children's Museum Story Time

item.title: Trivia Night - Earth Quest: Tic-Tac-Know
item.description: Join us with your family and friends for trivia night at the Energy Exhibit, where you can play in friendly rounds and put your general knowledge to the test! Every journey starts with one step... A quick adventure through time, where ancient rocks tell the Earth's story in a deep, silent voice. Choose your card, accept the challenge and let the stones reveal their secrets.

item.title: Grand Art Space
item.description: The Grand Art Space a vibrant world of color and motion where children let their imaginations run wild through painting, play, and creative movement. A place where drawing is free, play is art, and laughter is shared. Each child gets to explore their own colors, express themselves, and create unique art with joy.”

item.title: Stories from Ithra's Library
item.description: Join us at Ithra’s Library with your family, where every Friday, we gather round and read a selection of gripping stories, work together to unravel the morals of each one of them, and discuss authors’ hidden meanings.

item.title: Family Game
item.description: Every month a new fun challenging and educational game for you and your family to play and spend unforgettable time together at Ithra library!

item.title: Toddler Saturday
item.description: Activities you can enjoy with your children aged three and younger and help develop their gross motors, fine motors and cognitive skills.

item.title: Workshop at the Library
item.description: Join us at the Ithra Library as we read a different story each time, enriching our imagination through it, followed by a workshop inspired by the tale to reinforce its values and deepen its meaning. You will also have the opportunity to use various materials and tools, repurposing them to create new shapes! Innovate and create with your friends and family, spending time full of knowledge, crafting unique pieces, and exploring fresh techniques.

item.title: Children's Museum - Free Monday
item.description: It's finally the first Monday of every month, where the Children's Museum opens its doors during different times throughout the day. Offering a special free ticket for you and your family to join us for two hours and a half and take part in fun and interactive workshops.

item.description: Activities you can enjoy with your children aged four and younger and help develop their various, blossoming skills. We are waiting for you!

item.title: Little Explorers
item.description: A space for your child to have fun and explore different scientific concepts freely. Join the Ithra Children’s Museum to grow your children’s minds through different games and a variety of challenges.

item.title: Dots on Letters
item.description: At Ithra’s Library, we will challenge you to read words without dots to make things more interesting! We are waiting for you and your family to take the challenge enjoy a lovely experience!

item.title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
item.description: Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers. Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

item.title: Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo
item.description: The Saudi Entertainment and Amusement (SEA) Expo, running for over 8 years in Riyadh, is the Kingdom’s premier platform for the global entertainment and attractions industry. Bringing together innovators, suppliers, and decision-makers from across the Middle East and Africa, the expo showcases the latest technologies and solutions shaping the future of leisure and attractions. More than just an exhibition, SEA Expo offers opportunities to connect with like-minded industry experts, foster collaboration, and take businesses to new heights in Saudi Arabia’s rapidly growing entertainment sector. Register Now

item.title: Podcast Production: From the Field to Storytelling
item.description: Producers have a strong intuition that allows them to uncover hidden stories and present them in a cohesive, professional, and engaging way. This means producers are always "on" in their daily lives—at family gatherings, waiting at traffic lights, chatting with the car service driver, or navigating heated debates at social events. Production isn’t just a job; it’s a lifestyle and a mindset. In this comprehensive course, participants will gain the essential skills and foundational knowledge needed to create a complete, professional podcast episode. item.title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
item.description: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

item.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
item.description: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

item.title: Ultra Gobi AlUla
item.description: Ultra Gobi AlUla marks the first international chapter of the legendary endurance series, bringing its two-decade legacy to the Kingdom's desert landscapes. Across distances from 30km to 400km, athletes traverse open desert, dramatic rock formations, and ancient trade routes. Supported by world-class race infrastructure, this is a journey through endurance, history, and place.

item.title: AlUla Trail Race
item.description: Every January, AlUla bursts into action with the AlUla Trail Race - a dynamic celebration of endurance and unity set against its breathtaking ancient landscape. Whether you’re tackling the ultra-marathon or cheering on the Kids Run, each course challenges the spirit while weaving through awe-inspiring heritage sites and sandstone wonders. This multi-day event invites runners and supporters alike to come together, creating memories that blend athletic grit with cultural discovery. Expect vibrant energy, international camaraderie, and a festival-like atmosphere the whole family can enjoy.

item.title: AlUla Tour
item.description: AlUla Tour is a major fixture on the international cycling calendar, attracting the world’s top teams and riders for a multi-stage race through one of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From dramatic desert backdrops to iconic landmarks like Maraya and the Oasis, each stage delivers high performance and unforgettable scenery in equal measure. Individual AlUla Tour stages will be announced closer to the race date, but previous editions have seen riders traverse routes from Old Town to Harrat Uwayrid and Winter Park to Wirkah Mountain.
